maddeler.e:
تقتضون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَضُونَ (taqtaḍūna) /taq.ta.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# تُقْتَضَوْنَ (tuqtaḍawna) /tuq.ta.dˤaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
